subject.title: feat: show auto-detected provider plans and billing

question: Should this PR establish contracts.usageProviders plus the structured balance/spend/budget snapshot as the public provider billing contract after the Usage page load regression is fixed?
rationale: The patch expands plugin API and provider billing semantics across bundled and third-party provider boundaries, which needs maintainer product/API intent beyond the mechanical UI loading fix.

options.title: Approve after load decoupling
options.body: Require the usage.status fetch to update provider cards asynchronously while keeping the additive billing contract and provider-owned discovery model.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers specify units, labels, reset semantics, and provider coverage for the public billing schema.

options.title: Defer dashboard billing
options.body: Keep provider status in existing CLI/chat/status surfaces and close or split this UI expansion if maintainers do not want the Usage dashboard to own billing cards now.

recommendation.title: Approve after load decoupling
recommendation.body: Require the usage.status fetch to update provider cards asynchronously while keeping the additive billing contract and provider-owned discovery model.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the linked issue and has the strongest recent history in provider usage, ClawRouter quota work, and the intended billing/UI direction.
